name: Fire Monarch
description: (Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:fire-resistance+)(Tag:maximum-energy+)You are the Fire Monarch, ruler of all Fire and Plasma; your energy is massively enhanced, as your soul is an eternal reactor. All your Fire and Plasma-related abilities below Mythical Tier are increased by one rank and cost less energy. All fire and heat-aligned beings instinctively recognize you as Monarch, and you are immune to Fire and Plasma-based abilities.
